title: sample-gate
overview: A synthetic capability that exists only to record the shapes the OpenSpec CLI prints for a spec gate.

requirements.name: Short rule
requirements.text: The sample gate SHALL accept a short requirement without comment.

scenarios.name: Short text
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a requirement is short
- **THEN** no length warning is printed

requirements.name: Long rule
requirements.text: The sample gate SHALL carry a requirement whose text runs well past the length limit, so that the validator reports it by index. It SHALL keep going with clauses that would belong in scenarios: when the first condition holds it does one thing, when the second holds it does another, and when neither holds it does a third. It SHALL also name every edge case inline, the empty input, the oversized input and the input in the wrong encoding, each with its own consequence. Finally it SHALL restate the whole rule once more in different words, which is the habit the warning exists to discourage in the first place.

scenarios.name: Long text
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** the gate validates this spec
- **THEN** the validator reports the requirement as very long

requirements.name: Middle rule
requirements.text: The sample gate SHALL keep a third requirement after the long one, so the long one sits at index one.

scenarios.name: Middle text
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a requirement follows a long one
- **THEN** its index is two
